head.t: Philips launches new imaging software bringing CT-derived information into live procedures
head.x: Royal Philips has announced the launch of Philips UniGuide 3D Live Guidance—an imaging solution bringing computed tomography (CT)-derived information into its Azurion imaging platform—in Europe and other CE-marked markets.

head.t: Philips wins £80k Cath Lab/radiology upgrade at Morriston Hospital
head.x: Swansea Bay University Health Board has awarded Philips Electronics UK an £80,100 contract for Technology Maximiser Plus Allura upgrades across three existing Philips imaging rooms at Morriston Hospital.

head.t: Philips wins £302k critical care patient monitoring contract at Prince Charles Hospital
head.x: Cwm Taf Morgannwg University Health Board has awarded Philips Electronics UK a £302,140 contract to supply, install and commission a critical care patient monitoring system, including patient monitors, transport monitors and central monitoring station infrastructure, for the Intensive Care Unit at…

head.t: FDA early alert: Philips Lumify ultrasound software issue linked to four deaths
head.x: Trade press reports an FDA early alert on Philips Lumify mobile ultrasound software failing to recognise registered transducers, blocking scanning until re-registration. Philips reported four deaths and eight serious injuries; a software update is in development.
